title: Neighborhood / pocket record
description: Structured data for one corridor pocket (city, town, master-planned community, or named area). This is infrastructure for FUTURE verified enrichment: every field except name and geographic_type may be null, and null always means 'unknown — do not guess'. Values must never be LLM-invented; see northfwliving-data/PROVENANCE.md. Fields whose real-world values are mutable or contestable (tax_rate, price_band, commute_estimates, MUD, PID, HOA, school_district, major_builders, new_construction_status) take a provenance envelope, not a bare scalar.

city.description: Containing city, when the pocket is not itself a city.

county.description: County or counties; pockets can span county lines — record what the source shows, or null.

coordinates.description: value: {lat, lon} of a representative center point.

school_district.description: value: list of ISDs serving addresses in the pocket. Address-specific assignment is NEVER derivable from this field — it exists to say which districts are in play.

employment_relationships.description: value: list of employer slugs (/employers/...) for which this pocket is commonly considered.

housing_mix.description: value: e.g. {single_family, townhome, apartment, build_to_rent} presence flags or shares.

major_builders.description: value: list of builders with active communities. Populate only from official builder/community sources.

price_band.description: value: {min, max, currency, as_of} for typical new/resale pricing. Modeled or compiled — say which in confidence/notes.

tax_rate.description: value: combined property tax rate in percent. Lot-specific rates vary; this is pocket-typical only and must cite the county/CAD source.

MUD.description: value: true/false/'varies' — whether MUD districts are present in the pocket.

HOA.description: value: true/false/'varies', with typical dues in notes only if sourced.

commute_estimates.description: value: map of employer slug -> qualitative band ('short'|'moderate'|'longer'). The site deliberately avoids fake-precise minute counts; keep that discipline here.

source.description: Record-level default source when field-level provenance is absent.

history.description: Superseded field values, appended when a provenanced field is updated: {field, old, replaced_date}.
